note: Stand-in paint. Scenario Art replaces the PNGs in place. Masters are named slot@2x.png; the loader tries that name first. Each back plate is scaled to the live view: scale = max((view_w + 2*drift) / layer_w, (view_h + 2*drift) / layer_h), where drift = pan_limit_px * that plate's on-screen motion, view is the visible world size at the current zoom, and layer is the texture size. This is recomputed when the viewport changes. Front leaves are screen-locked. The leaf shader fades out over every cell diamond, over each fighter, and over a wider diamond on the hovered cell, so a leaf never covers a fighter or a clickable cell. Every leaf and backdrop control uses mouse_filter ignore, so clicks pass through. Each leaf has an 8-bit greyscale sway mask at half size: 0 pinned, 255 full swing. leaf_shadow is greyscale, white = lit, multiply, green tint and a slow scroll in the shader. Import is linear with no mipmaps. back_far and back_mid are BC7/VRAM. Leaves, sway masks and the shadow are lossless.
parallax_meaning: The number is the fraction of camera motion visible on screen, Godot scroll_scale style. 0 is screen-locked. 1 slides one-to-one with the pan. back_far 0.12 barely moves on screen. back_mid 0.40 moves more than the far canopy. Front leaves are screen-locked (0) and stay in the screen margins. A camera-centered plate is offset by -pan * fraction.
